title: Snow Fairy
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Wildlife photographer Narumi comes to Hokkaido to photograph birds known as 'snow fairies', is stranded in a snowstorm, and spends the winter at the home of young farmer Haruki, who has lived alone since his parents died. Narumi teaches Haruki photography and a slow romance grows between the two men.
life_message: It suggests that patience, gentleness and openness to love can heal loneliness and grief.

content.note: Romance between two adult men with an age gap; reviewer says it 'isn't explicit' (ANN; AniList Boys' Love, Age Gap).
Grief over parents' deaths and fear of being left alone (ANN; MU Dead Parent/s, Traumatic Past).
